quality_per_cost_comparison.allocation_unit: Owner review/authoring routing, not training mixture weights.
quality_per_cost_comparison.baseline: Frozen main policy uses a 1/10 evaluation-focus gate and normal-priority fallback; normal main pool has154 IDs. All three sampled coverage records are outside that normal pool.
quality_per_cost_comparison.concrete_alternative: For one future ten-slot review block, reserve one slot for a current-hash coverage-contract review, retain one evaluation-focus slot, and use eight normal-priority slots instead of nine. Select the coverage slot deterministically from the sampled records with a concrete missing teaching/size receipt, beginning with the pinned frame-depth record. This is a proposal only; no pool or weight is changed.
quality_per_cost_comparison.mechanism: The coverage slot checks a specific missing source-bound lesson/size contract. It can produce an actionable support limit or verified four-query receipt; public-evaluation ancestry and provenance are not quality criteria. Any unapproved candidate remains review-only until separately accepted.
quality_per_cost_comparison.quality_metric: Distinct query inputs retained in a same-rule, source-current, Racket-labeled, lesson-supported four-query episode, together with actually covered semantic/size strata. Report approval-eligible and review-only results separately; do not credit review-only records as production training yield.

planned_cost_estimate.label: Planning estimate/ceiling, not observed runtime
planned_cost_estimate.comment: With equal ten-minute caps and one four-query episode per tested slot, nominal review and base label-call budgets are equal. Extra labels for diagnostics/retries must count against the same cap; no success-time or retention-rate estimates were measured.

cell_cost_proxy.label: Analytical shape proxy, not tokenizer or runtime measurement
cell_cost_proxy.interpretation: A24x24 same-size input/output pair has576+576 cells versus116+4 for the panel canonical profile. The large frame case may cost much more in tokens, Racket work, or review despite equal pair counts. Actual token and time costs must be measured; sparse grids and encoding prevent identifying this ratio with token cost.

quality_per_cost_comparison.break_even: No numerical quality gain is supported by this sample. At equal measured total cost the coverage lane must increase retained distinct, lesson-supported targets or meaningful strata per unit cost. If its actual cost is r times the displaced normal slot, it needs more than r times that slot's useful yield to improve the ratio. For illustration only,20% extra cost requires more than20% extra useful yield; this is arithmetic, not a prediction.
quality_per_cost_comparison.provisional_judgment: A small evidence-driven coverage reservation is worth testing because packet coverage records can remain outside normal review routing, and the sampled current defaults visibly miss large-output strata. Evidence does not justify changing source-wide training shares or favoring one provenance.

bounded_future_test.status: PROPOSED; not run and not production support
bounded_future_test.design: Freeze source/rule hashes and predeclare two disjoint seeds. Under the existing policy choose one normal main-pool control; compare it with the pinned frame-depth coverage-contract review. Owner may first inspect existing source-bound four-query receipts. At most two four-query episodes per arm (4 episodes total), with4 demos and4 queries per episode:16 candidate supervised queries and32 base Racket pair labels total. Candidate frame settings, if attempted, are grid_h=24, grid_w=24,n_frames=4,n_shapes=6; these are source-visible candidate values only, not a validated production override. Keep defaults/small cases in the other episode. No other sampled provisional record is admitted automatically.
bounded_future_test.limits: At most20 reviewer minutes total and one probe<=120 seconds per arm; no models, full battery or census. The owner must authorize this later experiment separately. This ticket does not execute it.
bounded_future_test.measure: Record actual reviewer minutes, Racket wall time/call count, rejection/repair reasons, raw and retained query counts, four distinct query-input hashes, per-query lesson diagnostics, dedup seconds, input/output shape and actual serialized tokens. Keep source-hash freshness and approval status in every receipt.
bounded_future_test.stopping_rule: Stop an arm immediately on stale source/rule identity, a semantic/label contradiction, inability to fit the declared demo policy, or the time/call budget. If fewer than four distinct lawful queries survive, record the concrete support limit rather than changing constraints or padding. Pending sources remain outside production. Advance the one-in-ten routing proposal only if all retained queries satisfy the contract and measured useful-yield/cost exceeds the matched control with additional semantic/size coverage; otherwise retain incumbent routing. With this tiny sample, any apparent gain is a pilot signal, not a source-wide optimum or a learning-performance claim.
